Metadata.title: Etienne Binginot — Portfolio
Metadata.description: Personal showcase site built around measured proof.

HomePage.metricsNote: No number is shown without a measurement method and a date — the rule is enforced by the Zod schema, not just documented.
HomePage.buttonsNote: Two flat colors of relief on the edges, never a blurred box-shadow. Hover swaps between two flat tones of the same ramp.
HomePage.chartsNote: Rendered 100% server-side, zero client JS: flat-color SVG, coordinates aligned to the 4px grid, shape-rendering: crispEdges. The logarithmic scale is called out explicitly (badge + axis suffix) whenever it's used.
HomePage.typeReadSample: Inter — reading typeface for prose and write-ups, measure capped at about 70 characters to stay comfortable on long paragraphs.
